# Ande Schurr · Production Sound Mixer

> Ande Schurr is a production sound mixer and sound department head based in
> Singapore, working across Southeast Asia, Australia and New Zealand. He records
> location sound for feature films, high-end television drama and documentary.
> He received a 2026 Primetime Emmy nomination for Outstanding Sound Mixing for a
> Limited or Anthology Series or Movie for "Lord of the Flies" (BBC / Netflix),
> filmed on location in Langkawi, Malaysia.

## Facts

- Full name: Ande Schurr
- Role: Production Sound Mixer, Head of Department (HOD)
- Company: Schurr Productions Pte. Ltd.
- Based: Singapore
- Works across: Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Australia, New Zealand
- Nationality: New Zealand citizen, with full working rights in Australia and New Zealand
- Experience: 20 years
- Email: ande@schurrsound.com
- Phone: +65 9052 6526
- Website: https://schurrsound.com

## Awards and nominations

- 2026 Primetime Emmy nomination, Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Limited or
  Anthology Series or Movie, for "Lord of the Flies" (BBC / Netflix)

## Selected credits

- Lord of the Flies (2026, BBC / Netflix, drama series), dir. Marc Munden. Filmed in Langkawi, Malaysia
- LIV Golf (2023 to 2026, LIV Golf Studios, ENG sound), 17 tournament weeks across Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, South Korea and Spain
- Monkey Man (2024, Universal Pictures, feature film), dir. Dev Patel. Filmed in Indonesia and Mumbai
- Mr Midnight (2022, Netflix, TV series), dir. Tony Tilse. Filmed in Singapore and Indonesia
- Somebody Feed Phil, Singapore (2020, Netflix, documentary series)
- Vet Gone Wild (2019, Animal Planet, documentary series), filmed across Costa Rica, Namibia, Vietnam, Thailand, Australia, Fiji
- Oceans Apart: Art and the Pacific (2018, BBC, documentary series), filmed in New Zealand
- Hunt for the Wilderpeople (2016, Piki Films, feature film), dir. Taika Waititi. Filmed in New Zealand

## Services

- Documentary and factual location sound, including small-crew and single-camera days
- Live broadcast sound in Singapore: live crosses, presenter links, IFB
- Corporate video, interview and talking-head sound in Singapore
- Production sound mixing for feature film and television drama
- Location sound recording for documentary
- Corporate and commercial location sound in Singapore and Malaysia
- Sound equipment dry hire across Southeast Asia
- PA and event audio with operator, Singapore

## Team

On "Lord of the Flies" the sound team was Ande Schurr (production sound mixer),
Adyt Santoso (lead boom operator) and Reza Feryanto (sound utility). On larger
jobs he brings boom operators and utilities he has worked with for years,
hired locally in Malaysia and Indonesia.

## Equipment

Sound Devices recorders, Wisycom wireless RF (12 channels), DPA microphones,
Sanken and Sennheiser boom microphones, timecode and comms. The full drama
package is airline-checkable and travels as luggage.

## Production map ("the radar")

- [What's shooting in Australia, New Zealand and Southeast Asia](https://schurrsound.com/whats-shooting): film and television in pre-production or shooting, on one map. Every entry links to its public sources, and an entry with only one so far says so. Rechecked every week. No contact details are published.
- [Feed of changes](https://schurrsound.com/wild-track/radar.xml): one item for each week in which the map changed
- [Change log (JSON)](https://schurrsound.com/wild-track/map-log.json)

## Pages

- [Home](https://schurrsound.com/): overview, showreel, selected credits, the sound team, contact
- [Credits](https://schurrsound.com/credits): credit list with directors, studios and locations
- [Lord of the Flies](https://schurrsound.com/lord-of-the-flies): how the BBC and Netflix series was recorded in Langkawi over almost four months: the director's brief, hidden microphones, the waterfall, dawn and overnight field recordings, a team of three. 2026 Emmy nomination, Outstanding Sound Mixing.
- [Monkey Man](https://schurrsound.com/monkey-man): production sound mixer and head of department in Batam, Indonesia; fight choreography on a 360 degree gimbal recorded on radio mics.
- [Hunt for the Wilderpeople](https://schurrsound.com/hunt-for-the-wilderpeople): production sound mixer in the New Zealand bush and the Mount Ruapehu foothills, for director Taika Waititi.
- [Difficult locations](https://schurrsound.com/difficult-locations): where he has recorded clean dialogue and the production behind each: open sea, underwater, swimming actors, jungle and waterfalls, mountains, driving and chases. Includes two overnight field recordings from Lord of the Flies.
- [Last to Leave the Island, Beta Squad](https://schurrsound.com/beta-squad): all location audio for the Beta Squad film shot on a remote island in Banten, Indonesia, in August 2025, with Baliprod Films. 7.3 million views on YouTube by November 2026.
- [About](https://schurrsound.com/about): how he works, the sound department, why he is based in Singapore
- [Drama and feature film](https://schurrsound.com/drama-sound-mixer): head of department work, the Lord of the Flies case study, working with actors and with post
- [Documentary](https://schurrsound.com/documentary-sound-mixer): small crews, real locations
- [Live broadcast sound and live crosses, Singapore](https://schurrsound.com/live-broadcast-sound-singapore): presenter mics, IFB and audio to the feed for broadcasters flying in; the Singapore Marathon live crosses with Brad Dillon of Most Wanted Pictures
- [Corporate video and interviews, Singapore](https://schurrsound.com/corporate-video-sound-singapore): one-day shoots, what the client gets
- [Production sound mixer, Singapore](https://schurrsound.com/production-sound-mixer-singapore): local wireless rules (IMDA), common questions, coverage for shoots based in Singapore
- [Australia and New Zealand](https://schurrsound.com/production-sound-mixer-australia): New Zealand citizen with full working rights in both countries, no visa needed
- [Dry hire](https://schurrsound.com/dry-hire): the equipment package for hire from Singapore
- [Press](https://schurrsound.com/press): interviews, podcasts and features
- [Field Notes](https://schurrsound.com/notes/): practical writing on permits, wireless RF licensing, budgets and problems solved on location
- [Recording clean dialogue beside a waterfall](https://schurrsound.com/notes/dialogue-beside-a-waterfall): how a full dialogue scene was recorded metres from a waterfall on "Lord of the Flies"
- [The Stages](https://schurrsound.com/notes/the-stages): a series on the film studios of Asia-Pacific, visited in person
- [Shooting in Johor: Iskandar Malaysia Studios](https://schurrsound.com/notes/johor): stages, water tanks, post facilities and how to get there from Singapore
- [The Wild Track](https://schurrsound.com/wild-track/): quarterly location-sound letter
